en-US.description: Let any AI agent use your iPhone or Android phone from your computer, with you in the loop.
en-US.longDescription: Pinky lets any agent (Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Codex, Cursor or a script) operate a real iPhone or Android phone over MCP, while you watch on your computer, approve risky steps, take over and review what happened. Approvals are enforced by Pinky's gateway, not by instructions to the agent.
en-US.name: Pinky
en-US.releaseNotes:
- Ask Pinky and Pinky on your phone can now remember things for later tasks. After a task it may suggest a note, such as a preference you told it or a quicker way through an app, and keeps it only if you choose Remember. See, edit or delete notes, or turn memory off, in Settings › Agents › Memory on the computer and Settings › Memory in the phone apps. Notes never hold passwords, codes, card, account, ID or phone numbers, or addresses, and each device keeps its own.
- Ask Pinky and Pinky on your phone now know their way around WeChat, Alipay, Meituan, Taobao, Xiaohongshu, Amap, Google Maps, Apple Maps, Clock, Calculator and Settings: they read a short guide when they open one of them.

zh-CN.description: 让任何 AI Agent 在你的电脑上操作 iPhone 或 Android 手机，关键一步由你决定。
zh-CN.longDescription: Pinky 让任何 Agent（Claude Code、Claude Desktop、Codex、Cursor，或者一段脚本）通过 MCP 操作真实的 iPhone 或 Android 手机。你在电脑上看着它干活，有风险的步骤由你批准，随时可以接管，事后还能回看。审批由 Pinky 的网关执行，不靠给 Agent 的指令。
zh-CN.releaseNotes:
- 「交给 Pinky」和手机上的 Pinky 现在能记住一些内容，留给以后的任务用。任务结束后，它可能建议记下一条，比如你说过的偏好，或者某个应用里更快的做法，你点「记住」才会保存。在电脑上的「设置 › 智能体 › 记忆」和手机应用的「设置 › 记忆」里可以查看、编辑、删除，也可以关闭记忆。记忆不会保存密码、验证码、卡号、账号、证件号、电话号码或地址，每台设备各存各的。
- 「交给 Pinky」和手机上的 Pinky 现在熟悉微信、支付宝、美团、淘宝、小红书、高德地图、Google 地图、Apple 地图、时钟、计算器和设置：打开这些应用时，会先读一份简短的指南。
